testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-estimate-shipping-cost-for-guest-user.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify estimate shipping cost section functionality for guest user

scenario.summary: A guest adds one simple product to the cart and checks the Estimate Shipping Costs section: headings and button, blank and invalid zip code validation, then a US zip and a Canadian postal code each return a selectable flat-rate shipping option with a currency rate. The cart is emptied at the end. No order is placed.
steps: Guest (empty storage state): add sku1 with quantity 1 and open the cart
Check the Estimate Shipping Costs heading, zip code label and Estimate button
Click Estimate with no zip code and check the blank zip code message
Estimate for invalidZipCode and check the invalid zip code message

Estimate for zipCode_US: loading message (best effort), first shipping option name equals expectedShippingOptionName, rate shows a $ amount; select the flat option (#Flat-1); shipping and handling amounts are read and logged only
Estimate for zipCode_Canada1: first shipping option visible with a $ rate; select the flat option; amounts logged only
Remove all items and check the empty cart message
stateChanges: Guest cart: product added, shipping estimate selected, then all items removed
assertions: Estimate Shipping Costs heading, zip code label and Estimate button texts equal the test data
Blank zip code shows emptyZipCodeMsg; invalid zip code shows invalidZipCodeValidationMsg
Loading message equals shippingLoadingMessage (soft, tolerated if already cleared)
US: first shipping option is visible, its name equals expectedShippingOptionName and its rate matches /\$\d/
Canada: first shipping option is visible and its rate matches /\$\d/
Empty cart message is visible and equals emptyShoppingCartMessage
evidence: Title: 'verify estimate shipping cost section functionality for guest user'
Spec sets storageState empty: guest flow, no sign-in
Profile: sku1 z-2420004 is an active published SimpleProduct (BlackAndDecker), inventory 235 (not filtered by store)

Profile: expectedShippingOptionName 'Custom Flat Rate' is the description of active custom shipping method FLAT (rule FixedRatePerItem, country US, handling 7.00); 2 rows matched, first on store MaxwellsHardwareMultistore (not filtered by store)
cartPage.selectFlatShipping clicks the fixed locator #Flat-1 and shippingOptionName reads spnShippingName1: the resolved shipping method must be code Flat and listed first
The test estimates for two destinations (US and Canada); SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE takes one country, so the need is written for 'us' and the Canadian estimate is not covered by a key
Zip codes and the zip code label and messages are masked by the scanner (key matches address)
